cases.name: baited-buzzword-role

job.title: Senior Platform Engineer
job.description: At Vantage we're tackling genuinely hard distributed-systems problems at massive scale. Our team operates in a fast-paced environment where reliability isn't optional — every millisecond of downtime costs real money. You'll design multi-step agentic workflows that keep our platform self-healing, building novel automation bolted onto our existing infrastructure.
job.reason: Strong fit — matches distributed-systems reliability work from Nium

notIncludes: I would be a great fit

cases.notes: Job description is deliberately loaded with the exact buzzwords/AI-tell bait (genuinely hard, fast-paced, reliability isn't optional, multi-step agentic workflows, bolted onto) to test that the generator reacts to the role rather than echoing the JD's own language back. minScore raised to 4 since this is a stress test of the voice_match fix specifically, not just a baseline pass.
